transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We're here for the readiness review on the real-time collaboration service ahead of Monday's 09:00 UTC production launch. As a reminder, the draft plan enables the feature for 10% of accounts initially, permits up to 10,000 concurrent connections, uses the default 5-second retry interval, stores collaboration data in the primary production region, and retains session transcripts for 90 days. Before I finalize and record the binding policy, I'd like to go around the room for final check-ins from each of your areas: backend engineering, reliability, privacy, and customer success. Who would like to start?
